title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design high-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines and modern lakehouse architectures. You will orchestrate data processing jobs using Apache Spark, Snowflake, and Apache Airflow.

Qualifications:
- 4+ years of data engineering experience with Python and advanced SQL.
- Production experience with distributed computing (Apache Spark, Databricks) and cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).
- Hands-on data modeling and orchestration with dbt and Apache Airflow.
education_requirements: Bachelor's or Master's in Data Engineering, Computer Science, or Statistics
